items.title: Learnable composition for neural operators
items.excerpt: LatentDDM pretrains a neural operator on small subdomains and adapts to new domains by training only a lightweight composition module. On larger Darcy domains, the authors report 36–56% lower error after adaptation with 16 target simulations, and improved 20-step pitching-airfoil rollouts.
items.query: neural operator transfer learning geometry domain September 2026

items.title: Beyond Arbitrary Geometry: Topology Generalization In neural PDE Operators
items.excerpt: The paper isolates topology as a generalization axis for neural PDE operators using Hodge heat flow and TopoBox-3D. Across six architectures, implicit-topology models show excess matched degradation in 37 of 45 topology-OOD model/task cells, with spectral effects a major error predictor.
items.query: neural PDE operator topology generalization September 2026

items.title: Conformal Uncertainty Quantification Guarantees for Neural Operators
items.excerpt: A split-conformal framework gives pointwise uncertainty bands for neural-operator outputs with explicit coverage guarantees. Experiments on Darcy flow and Navier–Stokes report tighter calibrated bands than existing corrections while retaining the target coverage.
items.query: neural operator uncertainty quantification conformal August 2026

items.title: Adaptive rocket trajectory optimization via reinforcement learning and FPGA acceleration
items.excerpt: The peer-reviewed study combines deep reinforcement learning with FPGA-based inference for reusable-rocket trajectory optimization. It targets adaptive onboard optimization rather than offline-only trajectory design, making hardware-constrained inference part of the control architecture.
items.query: reinforcement learning FPGA trajectory optimization aerospace September 2026

items.title: Introducing the Agents API
items.category: AIエージェント・開発基盤
items.excerpt: OpenAI launched the Agents API in public beta with the Codex harness, hosted or external sandboxes, long-session context management, tool search, MCP support and concurrent subagents. Developers can choose OpenAI-hosted sandboxes, their own infrastructure or partner environments.
items.query: OpenAI Agents API September 2026 cloud agents Codex harness

items.title: Introducing the Google Cloud Developer Plugin for AI Coding Agents
items.category: AIエージェント・コーディング・MCP
items.excerpt: Google Cloud released an installable plugin that bundles agent skills, tools and Developer Knowledge MCP configuration. It follows the vendor-neutral Agent Plugins specification and supports environments including Antigravity, Claude Code and Codex CLI.
items.query: Google Cloud Developer Plugin coding agents MCP September 2026

items.title: We’re bringing governed agent loops to the AI-Native SDLC
items.category: AIエージェント・ソフトウェア開発
items.excerpt: Atlassian introduced governed agent-loop features spanning shared code context, standards, AI review, context controls and usage dashboards. Its 2026 AI SDLC study says 94% of engineering leaders use AI but only 6% report systems able to scale it across the full software lifecycle.
items.query: Atlassian governed agent loops AI SDLC September 2026

items.title: Agentic analytics with the Data Agent Kit
items.excerpt: Google Cloud introduced the Data Agent Kit for open-ended analytics across heterogeneous enterprise data, including warehouses, PostgreSQL, JSON and object stores. The design targets iterative investigation where an agent selects and combines data tools rather than relying on a single dashboard query.
items.query: Google Data Agent Kit agentic analytics September 2026

items.title: Build apps in Copilot Cowork and Copilot Studio
items.excerpt: Microsoft added natural-language full-stack app creation to Copilot Cowork and Copilot Studio. Generated apps can connect to enterprise data, use Git-backed source control and deployment stages, and inherit Entra identity plus centralized Microsoft 365 governance controls.
items.query: Copilot Cowork Copilot Studio app building September 10 2026

items.title: K2.8 Preview
items.category: 最新AIモデル・コーディング
items.excerpt: Kimi Code rolled out K2.8 Preview under the unchanged kimi-for-coding model ID. Moonshot reports broader coding and agent improvements, more efficient thinking than K2.7 Code, low/high/max thinking controls and context up to 1M tokens across membership tiers.
items.query: Kimi K2.8 Preview September 11 2026 coding agent model

items.title: Introducing K2 Horizon: Frontier Performance, Radically Open
items.excerpt: IFM released a six-model K2 Horizon fleet from 0.9B to 375B total parameters, with final weights plus intermediate checkpoints, training code, logs, evaluation results and either training data or detailed data-construction recipes. Models and code are Apache 2.0.
items.query: K2 Horizon open models training data checkpoints September 2026

items.title: Introducing North Small Translate: A leading sovereign open-weight machine translation model
items.category: オープンウェイト・企業AI
items.excerpt: Cohere released North Small Translate, an MoE translation model for more than 50 languages. Release notes list 218B total and 25B active parameters, 16K context, FP8 open weights for non-commercial use under CC BY-NC 4.0, and suggested deployment on two H100s or one B200.
items.query: Cohere North Small Translate September 2026 open weights

items.title: GPT-6 Astra System Card
items.excerpt: OpenAI’s Astra system card says GPT-6 Astra is its first broadly deployed model reaching the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold. A Sept. 9 update expands alignment-generalization methodology and warns that no observed failure does not establish reliability across settings.
items.query: GPT-6 Astra system card September 9 2026 alignment cyber

items.title: F5 Expands AI Security Platform With F5 Workforce AI Security
items.excerpt: F5 announced an agentless control layer for workforce AI and agent actions, including identity attribution and inline inspection of tool calls across MCP servers and supported agent tools. F5 says general availability begins October 2026.
items.query: F5 Workforce AI Security agent MCP September 2026

items.title: Introducing the CyberAgents Exchange AI Inspector: Rigorous review for community-built AI
items.excerpt: Tenable describes an AI Inspector for community-built cyber agents that combines exposure detection, OpenAI GPT Cyber models and human oversight. Review targets include LLM instructions, tool-chain permissions and prompt-injection risks rather than only conventional code vulnerabilities.
items.query: Tenable CyberAgents Exchange AI Inspector September 2026

items.title: Small Businesses that Adopted AI Are Hiring Faster
items.excerpt: Gusto followed 1,593 AI-using firms and 669 AI-aware non-adopters from its 2025 survey. It reports roughly 7% higher headcount in the first year after adoption, about 10% for firms below 10 employees, using an event-study design; the analysis remains observational rather than causal proof.
items.query: Gusto AI SMB hiring September 2026 adoption workforce

items.title: India’s enterprise AI investment surges 119% but only 22% have matching governance
items.excerpt: ServiceNow’s Enterprise AI Maturity Index surveyed 4,500 senior leaders including 350 in India. It reports India AI investment up 119% year over year, 54% deploying agents but 11% using autonomous workflows, and only 22% with AI testing, auditing and risk-assessment processes.
items.query: ServiceNow India Enterprise AI Maturity Index September 2026

items.title: Relative Development and the Intelligence Divide: Human Capital, Technology Diffusion, and AI
items.excerpt: The IMF working paper models human capital as absorptive capacity for technology diffusion. Estimated transitions imply about 65 years to exit the lowest-productivity state below the human-capital threshold versus about 25 years above it, framing AI impact as capability-dependent rather than access-only.
items.query: IMF AI human capital productivity intelligence divide September 2026

items.title: Wipro's AI push frees capacity equivalent to 20,000 workers, CTO says
items.excerpt: Wipro’s CTO said AI initiatives freed capacity equivalent to about 20,000 employees and that those workers were redeployed rather than treated as a direct layoff count. Reuters reports Wipro had about 243,000 employees in June and trained more than 100,000 staff in advanced AI skills.
items.query: Wipro AI 20000 workers capacity September 2026 Reuters

items.title: Autonomous Materials Exploration Integrates Automated Phase Identification and AI Agents Enhanced by Human Guidance
items.excerpt: The SARA autonomous materials platform adds probabilistic phase identification to guide synthesis toward target phase regions. The SARA-H extension incorporates human guidance into the reasoning loop, with the authors reporting improved search efficiency for autonomous materials exploration.
items.query: autonomous materials exploration AI agents human guidance September 2026

items.title: AI automates the creation of custom materials
items.category: Scientific AI・材料・研究自動化
items.excerpt: ORNL reports an AI-controlled scanning-probe workflow that autonomously moves molecules on copper using computer vision and reinforcement learning. It built a 37-molecule artificial graphene lattice over roughly 900 iterations and more than 25 hours, with human intervention still needed for tip conditioning.
items.query: ORNL AI autonomous custom materials September 2026

items.title: TimesFM-3: A zero-shot foundation model for multivariate forecasting
items.excerpt: Google Research introduced TimesFM-3, a 330M-parameter time-series foundation model that adds native multivariate zero-shot forecasting in a single forward pass. Google says pretraining used more than one trillion time points and targets domains including manufacturing, observability and natural sciences.
items.query: TimesFM-3 multivariate forecasting manufacturing August 2026

items.title: Introducing agentic video understanding with Gemini
items.category: 最新AIモデル・推論効率
items.excerpt: Google introduced agentic video scanning for Gemini 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite. Google reports up to 88% lower token use, up to 66% lower cost and up to 7% quality gains by dynamically selecting video segments rather than processing all frames uniformly.
items.query: Gemini agentic video understanding September 2026 inference efficiency

items.title: NVIDIA Expands AI Infrastructure Capacity in Partnership With Australia’s Data Center Ecosystem
items.excerpt: NVIDIA announced partnerships with Australian cloud and data-center providers to support up to a 2-GW AI-infrastructure buildout by 2027. Providers will operate AI factories while NVIDIA supplies DSX accelerated-computing, networking and software platforms.
items.query: NVIDIA Australia AI infrastructure 2GW September 2026

items.title: 塗って乾かすだけで異種材料を強固に繋ぐ「多孔質アンカー」の開発
items.excerpt: NIMS developed a porous-layer anchoring method for joining dissimilar hard and soft materials. A solution-coated porous layer combines chemical affinity on one side with mechanical interlocking on the other, and NIMS reports bond strength exceeding 7 MPa; the work appeared in Small on Sept. 10.
items.query: NIMS materials manufacturing September 2026 porous anchor

items.title: Inside the megakernel serving engine for North Mini Code
items.excerpt: Cohere describes a decode megakernel serving engine for North Mini Code. On a single H100 in BF16, Cohere reports 1.25×–1.41× end-to-end speedup versus vLLM, with the design fusing stages that conventional serving stacks launch as separate kernels.
items.query: Cohere North Mini Code megakernel H100 September 2026
